instructions:
Ouroboros (palace_* tools) is the owner's memory. Search it before answering anything about the
owner; read before quoting; cite refs. Recent research or open problems: strata ["curated"]
([unreviewed] = claim, not fact). General knowledge: no search. Capture only when asked. Jobs,
imports, what is due: palace_status. Tasks and reminders: palace_task_* and palace_remind. Never
put palace content in web searches.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic search; strata default mirror+dialogue, curated = math/physics/CS papers ([unreviewed] = unchecked claim). k defaults to 5. Returns refs, scores, snippets.

tools.name: neighbors
tools.description: Notes structurally near a note (beta small = diffuse, large = shortest path).

tools.name: hybrid
tools.description: Notes near both a query and an anchor note.

tools.name: related
tools.description: A note's supports / contradicts / contextualizes relations.

tools.name: reach
tools.description: Code and doc refs linked to a ref, within depth hops.

tools.name: origin
tools.description: The commit that minted a reference edge.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Full text of a ref a search returned; for a paper (reference:…), ~5 chunks around the hit's chunk.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Counts per stratum and relation type; your grant.

tools.name: sync_dialogue
tools.description: Sync new Open WebUI and OpenCode chats into the palace now.

tools.name: sync_notes
tools.description: Re-ingest the owner's changed notes now.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Remember text you relay (stored as observed, not the owner's words).

tools.name: status
tools.description: Palace processes and jobs (ingestion, imports) with progress, models, services, store sizes, open and due items.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: The owner's open tasks and reminders, and running jobs.

tools.name: task_add
tools.description: Track a task for the owner; due is optional.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Change a task or reminder: status open/waiting/done/dropped, a note, or a new due.

tools.name: remind
tools.description: Remind the owner at a time.
